description: Supplied deuteron baseline: owner-confirmed n=1 with half-wave length 3.580 m at nominal 32.7 MHz. A +/-3% length trim is an explicit working interpretation of 'a few percent', not a measured uncertainty. Other nominal component values are assumptions pending characterization. All 500 bins are retained.

cable_tuning.source: Owner's setup information: n=1, lambda/2=358.0 cm, installed length very close to this. Paper Sec. 2 supports integer half-wave tuning and velocity factor approximately 0.78.

reference_hz.source: User-confirmed nominal center for the 500-bin deuteron baseline acquisition; not an independent measurement of exact resonance

drive_v.source: Nominal engineering seed, not an independently confirmed RF voltage

drive_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal source resistor; replace with measured value/tolerance

input_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal input loading; replace with characterized value

damping_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal damping resistor; replace with measured value/tolerance

coil_resistance_ohm.source: Nominal RF coil resistance; replace with characterization

coil_inductance_h.source: Nominal coil inductance; replace with characterization

tune_capacitance_f.source: Unknown capacitor setting. Initial 800 pF is approximately 1/(omega^2 L0) for nominal 30 nH at 32.7 MHz; bounds are a numerical search range, not a measured component tolerance.

stray_capacitance_f.source: Unknown shunt parasitic capacitance; numerical 0-400 pF search interval, not a measured tolerance.

cable_resistance_ohm_per_m.source: Nominal distributed cable resistance; replace with characterization

cable_inductance_h_per_m.source: Derived jointly with cable C from beta(32.7 MHz)=pi/3.580 m and nominal sqrt(L/C)=50 ohm, retaining nominal R=3.43 ohm/m and G=0; not an independent inductance measurement.

cable_conductance_s_per_m.source: Explicit negligible dielectric-leakage approximation, not a measured zero

cable_capacitance_f_per_m.source: Derived jointly with cable L from the known 3.580 m half-wave and nominal 50 ohm impedance; see tools/fit_tuned_baseline.py calibrated_cable_lc.

cable_delta_length_m.source: Working hard bound +/-3% of 3.580 m, implementing the owner's 'a few percent' near n=1. Not a measured 1-sigma uncertainty; do not widen to compensate for model mismatch.

detector_phase_slope_rad_per_hz.source: Constant-phase approximation; replace if a phase-versus-frequency measurement exists

detector_phase_curvature_rad_per_hz2.source: Constant-phase approximation; replace if a phase-versus-frequency measurement exists

readout_gain.source: Unknown effective detector/DAQ mapping. Solve a Re(u)+b Im(u)+d by linear least squares at every circuit step; A=hypot(a,b), phi0=atan2(-b,a). RF drive held fixed; no physical gain or phase measurement is claimed.

readout_phase_rad.source: Unknown effective detector/DAQ mapping. Solve a Re(u)+b Im(u)+d by linear least squares at every circuit step; A=hypot(a,b), phi0=atan2(-b,a). RF drive held fixed; no physical gain or phase measurement is claimed.
